title: Champagne Carré Bracelet
descriptionHtml:
Champagne, squared off. A tennis bracelet of square princess cut champagne cubic zirconia of about 4mm, each stone in its own square gold four claw setting and linked edge to edge, so the line reads as one unbroken band of warm colour. It closes with a slim fold over clasp. Wear it every day with gold, or to a festive lunch when you want a glow rather than a flash.

STYLING TIP: Pair it with a clear line bracelet so the champagne sits between two rows of light.

Details

  • Length: Approximately 17cm
  • Stone: Square princess cut champagne cubic zirconia, approximately 4mm each
  • Setting: Square gold four claw settings, linked edge to edge
  • Closure: Fold over clasp
  • Finish: Polished gold tone
  • Plating: PVD 18K gold coating, anti-tarnish
  • PVD vs plating: Regular plating is a soft layer that wears off over time. PVD is bonded to the metal in a vacuum, so it is far harder, stands up to sweat and keeps its colour much longer.

Care

Keep it dry and away from perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.
